items.title: Don't copy your resume
items.detail: The committee already has your resume. Your SOP should explain why and how.

items.title: Don't start with a quote
items.detail: Everyone uses famous quotes. Start with one real story of your own.

items.title: Not the same SOP for all
items.detail: Adjust each SOP a little for the course, the faculty and your fit.

items.title: Read it out loud
items.detail: Where you stumble, shorten the line. Simple English is the strongest.

youtube.title: Writing your SOP? Avoid these 4 mistakes
youtube.description:
